column3: Each Issue #N edit is one op: title, description, due (date input or Clear) and the whole assignee list go through issue.update, and links through issue.link / issue.unlink; a bad_args message shows under the field that sent it, and re-reads stay on issues.rev
column4: the contract's update replaces list fields, so an add or remove sends the full list; the write's own result patches the view until the settled rev re-reads it
